title: RHOL's Nessie Welschinger on her Singaporean and Egyptian roots, and London upbringing
excerpt: Her mum had a huge impact on Singapore
content:
Credit: Left - Hayu. Right - Instagram

Nessie Welschinger is super successful, and two people who played a huge role in her upbringing are her parents. The RHOL star is now the owner of a highly-established cake company in London, years after she was raised in the city with Singaporean and Egyptian roots. 

Her mum, Peggy Quek, has featured in five RHOL episodes and served as CEO and Board Director of AIA International Wealth in Singapore from January 2024 to July 2026, following over three decades in Asian wealth management and banking at many institutions.

Before RHOL aired its first season on Hayu, she told The Independent: “I was born and bred in London. So I spent all my childhood here. And obviously, I also come from immigrant parents who moved from Singapore and Egypt to find a home in London.”

“Growing up in a multicultural home and experiencing different walks of life, particularly in London, I believe that shaped who I am. That’s opened my eyes to the difference that London makes to the rest of the world. I feel like RHOL brings out the best of London.”

I love Nessies mom.
byu/therealelena inrholdn

Nessie’s parents met at a house party in central London, which led to her being taught how to prepare Singaporean dishes. She has even prepared Singaporean kaya jam for castmates. Her mum paved the way for wealth, because CEOs at her firm make $14 million a year!

She often calls Peggy her “role model” and wrote: “Congratulations to mummy for accepting an award at Istana (President’s Palace in S’pore) for outstanding contributions to Singapore! So proud of everything you are and everything you do!! 👏🏻👏🏻.”
